description: A sequencer over a grid of 64 steps, clocked at one rate across and another down, whose enabled steps are mutated and shifted as the active step moves

params.text: Sets the run direction: down for forwards, centred for stopped, up for backwards
Sets the rate at which the active step moves horizontally, 0 to 1000 BPM
Sets the rate at which the active step moves vertically, 0 to 1000 BPM
Returns the active step to step 1 in both directions, and flashes the light red
Moves the active step one column to the right, firing the triggers and applying the mutate and shift settings
Moves the active step one column to the left, firing the triggers and applying the mutate and shift settings
Moves the active step one row down, firing the triggers and applying the mutate and shift settings
Moves the active step one row up, firing the triggers and applying the mutate and shift settings
Moves the active step one column right and one row down at once, firing the triggers and applying the mutate and shift settings
Moves the active step one column left and one row up at once, firing the triggers and applying the mutate and shift settings
Enables mutation of the neighbouring step in that direction each time the active step moves; adjacency wraps around the edges of the grid
Shifts the next active step one step in that direction; all shift directions are worked out together, so opposite ones cancel
Toggles that step between enabled and disabled; the active step fires triggers only when it lands on an enabled step
Sets what an enabled mutation direction does to the neighbouring step: up enables it, centred toggles it, down disables it
Randomises which steps across the grid are enabled

inputs.text: Overrides the run switch: above 1V runs forwards, below -1V runs backwards, any other non-zero voltage stops it, and 0V leaves the switch in charge
Adds 100 BPM per volt to the horizontal rate, after both the knob value and the voltage are truncated to whole numbers; a negative result pauses the rhythm
Adds 100 BPM per volt to the vertical rate, after both the knob value and the voltage are truncated to whole numbers; a negative result pauses the rhythm
A trigger above 0V moves the active step to column 1, and fires that step again if it is enabled
A trigger above 0V moves the active step to row 1, and fires that step again if it is enabled
A signal above 0V here, at the same moment as one on a row input, toggles the step where that column and that row cross
A signal above 0V here, at the same moment as one on a column input, toggles the step where that row and that column cross
Any signal above 0V enables mutation of the neighbouring step in that direction each time the active step moves
Any signal above 0V shifts the next active step one step in that direction
Overrides the mutation type switch: above 2.5V enables, below -2.5V disables, any other non-zero voltage toggles, and 0V leaves the switch in charge
A trigger moves the active step one column to the right
A trigger moves the active step one column to the left
A trigger moves the active step one row down
A trigger moves the active step one row up
A trigger randomises which steps across the grid are enabled

outputs.text: A trigger at the horizontal rate, whether or not the step it lands on is enabled
A trigger at the vertical rate, whether or not the step it lands on is enabled
A trigger when the active step moves horizontally onto an enabled step in that column
A trigger when the active step moves vertically onto an enabled step in that row
A trigger whenever the active step lands on an enabled step, in either direction
1.25V to 10V for the column the active step is in, 1.25V per column
1.25V to 10V for the row the active step is in, 1.25V per row
0.15625V to 10V for the number of the active step, counted 1 to 64 from the top left

notes: nothing fires until the run switch is off centre, one of the BPM knobs is above 0 and at least one step is enabled; a step is enabled by clicking it
menu: CV Param Mode sets how every CV input acts on its knob: Offset adds the CV to it, Follow sets it from the CV, Attenuate scales the CV by it
Clamp CV Values keeps a value driven by CV inside the range of its knob; switched off, the value can go past that range

inputs.3: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.4: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
